rules.statement: Where a plot of ground has been fenced off and used for burial purposes for more than twenty years without any objection, it is sufficient to raise the presumption of dedication to the public and constitutes the plot a res religiosa, such that a conveyance does not pass title to it.
rules.supporting_quote: Where, in an action rei vindicatio, it was proved that the plot of ground in question had been fenced off and used for burial purposes for more than twenty years without any objection on the part of the plaintiff's predecessors in title, held, that this was sufficient to raise the presumption of dedication to the public and to constitute the plot a res religiosa, and that therefore the conveyance in favour of the plaintiff did not pass any title to him.
